Our story

Two countries, one gate

Celtic Bull started as a patch of polytunnels and a few trays of seedlings, and grew into a working smallholding where Irish welcome meets Polish know-how. Everything we sell, we can tell you how it was grown — our herbs are pinched back by hand, and our bestselling apples travel from the same Polish orchards our family has picked for generations.

Nothing here is mass-produced. If it's on our shelf or on your plate, someone here grew it, made it, or picked it themselves — that's the whole idea.

Home-made Bio & organic Family-run Grown on-site
Shop & garden centre

From seed tray to your garden

Every spring our benches fill row by row — sedums and thyme spilling over their pots, trays of seedlings finding their first true leaves, herbs multiplying faster than we can pot them on. Come and dig through what's ready this week, ask us anything, and leave with plants that are already halfway home.

Next door: the organic pet store

Bio and cold-pressed feeds, natural treats, and everything else your dog needs before a walk down to the beach. Our shelves lean toward the same principle as the garden centre — fewer ingredients, better ones.

Local area

On the Copper Coast

We're on the coast road between Dungarvan and Tramore, Co. Waterford — cliff paths, hidden coves and Blue Flag sand, most of it a short drive from our gate. Fill a basket at the farm shop, then spend the afternoon at:

~15 MIN DRIVE

Clonea Beach

A long, family-friendly Blue Flag strand near Dungarvan — the one most locals mean when they just say "the beach".

~10 MIN DRIVE

Ballyvoile Cove

A sheltered cove tucked below the old railway viaduct, quieter than the bigger beaches nearby.

~10 MIN DRIVE

Ballydwan Beach

Small, easy-going and rarely crowded — good for a flask of tea and an hour of rock-pooling.

~15 MIN DRIVE

Stradbally Cove

A pebble-and-sand cove backed by the village of Stradbally, with a path along the cliffs above it.

~20 MIN DRIVE

Annestown & Tramore

Annestown's low-key strand, or push on to Tramore's long beach, promenade and amusements for a full day out.

Ask in the shop for our own route around the coast road — it's the one we send visiting family on, beaches and all.
